ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
B3-2, Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map

No. 28-E in the area bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel to East 112" Place; a line 24.2 feet
west of and parallel to the alley next west of and parallel to South
Michigan Avenue; East 112" Place; a line 24.2 feet west of and parallel to
the alley next west of and parallel to South Michigan Avenue; the alley
next south of and parallel to East 112" Place; a line 49.2 feet west of and
parallel to the alley next west of and parallel to South Michigan Avenue;
East 112th Place; and a line 25 feet east of and parallel to South State
Street,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
